hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - Ten of Hearts
hln.us.description: A 20-year-old woman sets out on her bike and never returns; her body is found a few miles from her house with a gunshot wound to the head; years go by without any evidence or leads, until new investigators and technology breaks the case.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - Heavy Metal
hln.us.description: A navy lieutenant is murdered while deployed out to sea; arsenic poisoning is the cause of death; investigators discover he had more than his fair share of enemies, but it takes years before investigators discover what really happened to him.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - Knots
hln.us.description: A building manager finds the lifeless body of a young woman in the bathtub; when questioned, an ex-con living downstairs lies to police; the lies do not prove murder and the case goes cold, then a new forensic tool examines the evidence.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - The Reunion
hln.us.description: A murder victim's final moments are caught on tape; the crime scene looks like a clear robbery-murder; text evidence at first points to a jilted lover, but police identify a second suspect with a motive.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - The Orange Shorts
hln.us.description: A wounded woman calls 911; her husband, who wants a divorce, gets a hard look from police, but he has an airtight alibi during the murder; forensic science of ballistics draws a direct connection.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - Personal Penmanship
hln.us.description: A religious woman is shot execution style in the suburbs of Michigan; surveillance video reveals it was a trio of killers; eventually, detectives get a break: a handwritten note.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - Full Circle
hln.us.description: Three sex workers are murdered and left along a river; a serial killer was on the loose and for years the perp was never identified.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files II - Matching Palms
hln.us.description: He is a sex offender and a murderer who attacks in a terrifying rage; this predator manages to evade capture for years, but he leaves evidence behind, his palm print; detectives are determined to put a face to the print.

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Headquarters
hln.us.description: When hunters find a skull in a Texas canyon, police find bits of clothing, a woman's shoe, some small bones and a strand of hair; once they discover her identity, it was time to find the killer. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2005-07-13

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - One for the Road
hln.us.description: A wife is missing in Key West; investigators wonder if they should be searching for a missing person or a killer. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2005-07-20

khon.us.description: This reality series profiles a group of young people who work aboard yachts that measure well over 100 feet long. The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. The crews live by the "work hard, play harder" motto that gives them access to exotic perks few people get to experience.

khon.us.title: 48 Hours
khon.us.description: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

mgmplushits.us.description: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it.

mgmplushits.us.title: New Wave - Message in a Bottle

mgmplushits.us.title: U-571
mgmplushits.us.description: When a German U-571 submarine with a sophisticated encryption machine onboard is sunk during a World War II battle at sea, the Allies send an American Navy force led by Lieutenant Andrew Tyler (Matthew McConaughey) to retrieve it for study. Boarding the German ship, the Americans' cover as a rescue force is quickly blown. Forced to take the crew hostage, the Americans lay their explosives and prepare to destroy the German vessel before the Nazis can send naval backup.

mgmplushits.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
mgmplushits.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Visitor
mgmplushits.us.description: When Robert and his wife move to her childhood home, he discovers an old portrait in the attic of a man who looks just like him. He soon travels down a frightening rabbit hole as he tries to discover the true identity of his mysterious doppelgänger, only to realize that every family has its own terrifying secrets.

mgmplushits.us.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
mgmplushits.us.description: There's a single piece of land around Flagstone with water on it, and rail baron Morton (Gabriele Ferzetti) aims to have it, knowing the new railroad will have to stop there. He sends his henchman Frank (Henry Fonda) to scare the land's owner, McBain (Frank Wolff), but Frank kills him instead and pins it on a known bandit, Cheyenne (Jason Robards). Meanwhile, a mysterious gunslinger with a score to settle (Charles Bronson) and McBain's new wife, Jill (Claudia Cardinale), arrive in town.

mgmplushits.us.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
mgmplushits.us.description: Tiffany travels to Derrick Lake to celebrate her 18th birthday at a Halloween frat party in the middle of the woods. Frantic and worried, Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie hop in the car to save her from the same terrible fate that befell a group of teens there years earlier. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of spooky monsters, goblins and boogeymen.

mgmplushits.us.title: Class
mgmplushits.us.description: Naive Midwestern prep student Jonathan (Andrew McCarthy) bonds with his more worldly roommate, Skip (Rob Lowe), who takes the small-town boy under his wing. At Skip's urging, the inexperienced Jonathan is emboldened to seek out older women in the cocktail lounges of nearby Chicago, where he meets and beds the alluring Ellen (Jacqueline Bisset), who unfortunately turns out to be Skip's mother. The division between the friends is further deepened when a cheating scandal engulfs the school.

mgmplushits.us.title: A Bridge Too Far
mgmplushits.us.description: Late in 1944, the Allies seem to have the upper hand in the European land war. A combined British and American paratrooper force, led by American general Gavin and British general Urquhart (Sean Connery), plans to take a highway leading from the Netherlands into Germany, so that British ground troops led by Lieutenant General Horrocks (Edward Fox) and Lieutenant Colonel Vandeleur (Michael Caine) can enter enemy territory. But the Allies soon learn that they may be overconfident. (movie) - 1977

mgmplushits.us.title: The Warriors

Soon they have every gang in the city out to get revenge, and they must make their way across the city to their own turf. (movie) - 1979

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Transformers: The Last Knight

The key to saving the future lies buried in the secrets of the past and the hidden history of Transformers on Earth. Now, it's up to the unlikely alliance of inventor Cade Yeager, Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the world.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra

Joe team take on Destro (Christopher Eccleston), a corrupt arms dealer, and fight the growing threat of the mysterious Cobra organization.

Meanwhile, Snake Eyes (Ray Park) is on a search for inner peace but learns that his nemesis, Storm Shadow, is still alive.

When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline.

Flashing back, we learn Doniphon saved Stoddard, then a lawyer, when he was roughed up by a crew of outlaws terrorizing the town, led by Liberty Valance (Lee Marvin). As the territory's safety hung in the balance, Doniphon and Stoddard, two of the only people standing up to him, proved to be very important, but different, foes to Valance.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Magnificent Seven

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - The Ultimate Beater Burnout Machine!

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Junkyard Rescue Four-Speed Big Block

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Parking Lot Engine Swap
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A Chevy-powered '74 Jaguar XJ12 needs a new engine; in homage to a previous fiasco, the guys return to a parking lot in Sparks, Nev., for the swap; they then follow a lead to fill the void left by the stolen Mazdarati.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Trading Cars Across Power Tour
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Mike and David drive a new car every day as they trade their way through the 25th Hot Rod Power Tour; each day, they'll swap their junk for someone else's and try to make it to the next stop on the tour.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Junkyard Rescue T-37 Pontiac!

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Episode 100: Back to Throwing Darts!

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Blasphemi Takes on Hot Rod Drag Week!

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
movies.us.description: With the IMF now disbanded and Ethan Hunt out in the cold, a new threat -- called the Syndicate -- soon emerges. The Syndicate is a network of highly skilled operatives who are dedicated to establishing a new world order via an escalating series of terrorist attacks. Faced with what may be the most impossible mission yet, Ethan gathers his team and joins forces with Ilsa Faust, a disavowed British agent who may or may not be a member of this deadly rogue nation.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
movies.us.description: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca, Saudi Arabia. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible -- Dead Reckoning Part One
movies.us.description: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team must track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity if it falls into the wrong hands. With control of the future and the fate of the world at stake, a deadly race around the globe begins. Confronted by a mysterious, all-powerful enemy, Ethan is forced to consider that nothing can matter more than the mission -- not even the lives of those he cares about most. (movie) - 2023

movies.us.title: Top Gun

When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (movie) - 1986

movies.us.title: Top Gun: Maverick
movies.us.description: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. (movie) - 2022

He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

mtv2west.us.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
mtv2west.us.description: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo.

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
mtv2west.us.description: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy.

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
mtv2west.us.description: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart.

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
mtv2west.us.description: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Danielle & BJ
mtv2west.us.description: Nev and Kamie get a letter from a woman worried that a guy named BJ is catfishing her friend Danielle; BJ comforted Danielle when somebody shot her, but now she needs to know who she's really been dating for the past six years.

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Imari & ?
mtv2west.us.description: Imari is about to fly to Atlanta to collab with her online musical mentor, but this mentor has been on the show before as the catfish.

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Matthew & Chance
mtv2west.us.description: Nev and co-host Kimiko Glenn help Matthew, who is on the search for his elusive Instagram love named Chance.

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Courtney & Chris
mtv2west.us.description: Courtney has been mad in love with her Turkish boyfriend for three years, but she met Chris while role-playing and is wondering if he's just a fantasy; Nev and Kamie cross digital borders to hunt the identity of her international mystery man. (Reality, Documentary) - 2021-05-11

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Oceanna & Nelly
mtv2west.us.description: Nev and Slick Woods investigate the mystery of Oceanna and her enigmatic online stalker, Nelly; when Oceanna's ex-girlfriend, Kira, becomes involved, the team wonders who is a victim and who is the perpetrator. (Reality, Documentary) - 2019-06-26

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - DeJuan & Tynea
mtv2west.us.description: Nev and Kamie unearth a mystery involving twin sisters; it threatens to extinguish DeJuan's love for Tynea forever. (Reality, Documentary) - 2020-12-15

mtv2west.us.title: Catfish: The TV Show - Dre and Casey
mtv2west.us.description: Still under lockdown, Nev and Kamie receive a request to help Dre finally meet elusive Casey; the request is so unconventional and the situation becomes so intense that the hosts question if they should continue the search. (Reality, Documentary) - 2020-08-19

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lenses
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Guinea Pigs
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Windmills
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when Mr. Bull arrives to do some noisy work - he is building a windmill, to make electricity! The children join in and make their own windmills too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pizza! Pizza!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig suggests they all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Canoe Trip
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then actually bump into Mrs Crocodile. Then Mr Lion invites them to a picnic.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Talking
nickjrtoo.uk.description: There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language. Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Favourite Sound
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of a muddy puddle.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Woodland Club
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are introduced to some simple woodcraft in the woods with Mr Wolf.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Tractor
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Lifeboat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea, and gives them tips on how to stay safe.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Superhero Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero-themed party and Super Potato is one of the guests.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Happily Ever After
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Movie Night
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Adventure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children make good use of their clubhouse by playing an adventure game, imaginging that there are wild animals outside - even if it is just Daddy Pig.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Breakfast Club
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cleaning the Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The family car is very muddy. Peppa and George have lots of fun helping Mummy and Daddy clean it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro's Cough
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Freddy Fox
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull's New Road
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy's Day Out
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic, and Zoe Zebra has to rescue him.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Baby Piggy
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cold Winter's Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is a very cold winter day. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the puddles are all frozen and slippery.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mirrors
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has fun looking at himself in the mirror and tries to find other shiny things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Shoes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never, ever wants to take them off - until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gardening
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Pig's Chickens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse. Grampy Rabbit knows all about the sea, and can make a lot of noise too, which is useful.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Rainy Day Game
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Daddy Pig's Office
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's all play and not much work when Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - School Camp
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are going camping. Madame Gazelle, their teacher, is in charge. First they put up their tents. Then they collect sticks to make a campfire.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gerald Giraffe
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Gerald Giraffe is new to playgroup! He's trying to make friends with Peppa and the group, but finds being so tall is making playing hide and seek quite a challenge.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Digger World
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr. Potato at Digger World.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mister Skinnylegs
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa doesn't like spiders and screams very loudly. But soon she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Delphine Donkey
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Computer
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Edmond Elephant's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rock Pools
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George learn there's lots of fun to be had at the beach, even when there's no sand.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Ambulance
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr. Brown Bear comes to visit the playgroup and teach all of the children what to do when there's been an accident.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Spider Web
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house and orders Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes, wherever he likes.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Police Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Swimming Lesson
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit takes the children for swimming lessons in the little children's pool. At the end of the lesson, giant inflatables are brought out including an inflatable slide.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Singing Competition
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Duck Race
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Big Build
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Made Up Musical Instruments
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playing Golf
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lots of Muddy Puddles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Babies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dr Hamster's Ant Farm
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep Moves In
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Funny Music
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cushion Den
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Takeaway
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Walkie Talkies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fire Station Practice
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig joins with the other mummies to practise fighting fires at the fire station. The fire brigade demonstrate their practice using their motto.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - World Book Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Indoor Adventure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Chloe's Birthday Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Inspired
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Trampolines
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep decide they want to have a go at trampolining.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit in Space
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Ballet Lesson
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson. Peppa loves dancing. Everyone loves dancing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Dinosaur is Lost
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has the best birthday ever, including a visit to the Dinosaur Museum.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Champion Daddy Pig
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper, until everyone helps him train to win it back.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Emily Elephant
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa meets her new playschool friend Emily Elephant.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Painting
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have fun making potato prints and painting a lovely picture of a cherry tree.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Suzy Goes Away
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Sandpit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George play at being pretty butterflies, wriggly worms and muddy frogs.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Piggy in the Middle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George play piggy-in-the-middle. George catches the ball with a little help from Daddy Pig.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Danny's Pirate Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Alexander
nickjrtoo.uk.description: What's that sound? Is it a car alarm? Is it a fire engine? No, it's Baby Alexander. Babies cry a lot - but Alexander likes listening to Peppa. She knows about all sorts of things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Shadows
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George notice they have shadows, and no matter how fast they walk, run, or jump - they can't lose them.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Nursery Rhymes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their best nursery rhymes with each other.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playgroup Star
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets her very first Playgroup Star in school for drawing a wonderful picture of her house.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Castle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Carnival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The Carnival has come to town and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting people and floats.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Playground
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa gets stuck in the tyre on the climbing frame, and Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Simple Science
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While the playground is getting rebuilt, Daddy Pig teaches the children some simple science.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Molly Mole
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Madame Gazelle's House
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Time Capsule
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends make a time capsule and bury it in the school garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Dentist
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr. Elephant the Dentist says that Peppa and George both have lovely clean teeth.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Please and Thank You
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when you say please and thank you.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lucky Hamper
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a Lucky Hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Folk Music Band
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Living Above the Shops
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lenses
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Guinea Pigs
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Windmills
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when Mr. Bull arrives to do some noisy work - he is building a windmill, to make electricity! The children join in and make their own windmills too.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy's Tree Dome has a flea problem in 'A Flea In Her Dome'. Patrick accidentally takes SpongeBob's donut and feels guilty in 'Donut of Shame', and SpongeBob is washing dishes in 'The Krusty Plate'.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob hears that a ferocious biker gang is coming to town in 'Born To Be Wild', and then in 'Best Frenemies', Mr Krabs and Plankton work together to investigate a new kelp smoothie store.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy takes on SpongeBob in a non-stop week of extreme sports in "Prehibernation Week", then in "Life of Crime", SpongeBob and Patrick borrow a balloon and end up on the run. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mysterious hooks appear in Bikini Bottom and Mr Krabs warns SpongeBob to stay away from them in 'Hooks', while in 'Mermaidman and Barnacleboy II' SpongeBob wins a big prize! (S1, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs wisely chooses SpongeBob and Patrick to decorate his living room in 'Wet Painters', and then in 'Krusty Krab Training Video', we learn about being an excellent employee.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob's predecessor pays a visit to the Krusty Krab in 'The Original Fry Cook', and then in 'Night Light', tales of the boogeyman send SpongeBob into a panic.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob becomes the richest Sponge in Bikini Bottom in 'Porous Pockets', and in 'Choir Boys', Squidward tries to avoid SpongeBob while on his way to an audition for the Bikini Bottom Men's Chorus.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick dig a tunnel between their two houses and drive Squidward nuts in 'That Sinking Feeling', and then in 'Karate Star', Patrick learns just enough karate to wreak havoc!

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day in 'A Finful of Sand Dollars', then in 'Cretins of the Night', SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night. (S2, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The Dinghy cabin camps overnight without any water in 'High and Dry', then in 'The Beardsman', wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp. (S2, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Squidward is sick, and SpongeBob worries that he has caught it too in 'Squiditis', then in 'Demolition Doofus', SpongeBob's bad driving makes him the star of the demolition derby.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: A storm sweeps the Krusty Krab away in 'Mutiny on the Krusty', and then in 'The Whole Tooth', Patrick's last baby tooth needs to come out, but he's afraid to let it go.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton hasn't tried to steal the secret formula in a while in 'Plankton Paranoia', then in 'Library Cards', Patrick discovers the pineapple's library, SpongeBob introduces him to the world of books.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins in 'Helter Shelter', then in 'Reveille Revolution', Squidward has to earn back his morning 'Reveille' duties. (S1, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Nobby becomes too civilized for Narlene in 'My Fair Nobby', and in 'Gimme a News Break', Perch and his pal Harvey report the news of Kamp Koral, but they discover evidence of a conspiracy! (S1, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Plankton must work together to survive in 'Delivery to Monster Island', then in 'Ride Patrick Ride', SpongeBob teaches Patrick how to ride a bike.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick hires other Patricks to entertain at parties in 'Too Many Patricks', then in 'Much Tofu About Nothing', Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products. (S2, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw in 'Braggin' Slayer', and in 'Scaredy Pat', after learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience. (S5, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty ...
nicktoons.uk.description: ..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy creates a new invention to avoid doing chores in 'Are You Smarter Than A Smart Cabin', and then in 'Deep Sea Despot', Squidward takes over as Camp Master. (S1, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob makes a delivery to E.V.I.L. in 'Delivery of Doom', then in 'My Father the Boat', Pearl gets a new boat. (S15, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Star Family is a team of superheroes in 'Super Stars', and then in 'Now Museum, Now You Don't', Cecil works security at Lady Upturn's art museum. (S2, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Patricks compete for control of the TV remote in 'Pat-Tathlon', then in 'Upturn's Downturn', after driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family. (S4, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Some undersea superheroes are back in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy III', and then in 'Squirrel Jokes', SpongeBob's derogatory comedy is not at all funny to Sandy Squirrel. (S2, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors in 'The Patrick Show Sells Out', then in 'Neptune's Ball', the Star family visits King Neptune's palace. (S1, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: In an episode about boats, Cecil teaches Patrick how to drive in 'Driven to Drive', then in 'A Patty in Time', Patrick time-travels in a race for the Krusty Krab's newest menu item. (S3, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs makes his number one employee take his first ever day off, in 'Bummer Vacation', and then in 'Wig Struck', SpongeBob finds an old wig, and wears it all around town, thinking that it's cool.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Gary's new habit causes a night of stress in 'Un-Breaking and De-Entering', then in 'Swimmin' Holed', Narlene and Nobby's secret swimming hole is exposed. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick decides it's time to start living life like Larry the Lobster in 'A Life In A Day', and then in 'Sun Bleached', SpongeBob tries to get a tan, with disappointing results.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick see a young Mermaidman and Barnacleboy in 'Back To The Past', and then there are more classic superhero adventures in 'The Bad Guy Club For Villains'.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Yard Sale: GrandPat prevents his precious memories from being sold at a family yard sale. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Bunny sends Squidina to camp, so Patrick works with new staff in 'Is there a Director in the House?', then in 'Star Cruise', the Star family enjoys a cruise ship vacation... in outer space. (S2, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs resorts to desperate measures after Plankton drives away his customers in 'Free Samples', and then in 'Home Sweet Rubble', SpongeBob's pineapple is falling apart, and needs re-modelling.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: When Gary gets lost outside, he has to go on an incredible journey to get back home in 'Food Con Castaways', and then in 'Snail Mail', Spongebob accidentally fibs to his pen pal, and must keep it up!

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The Dinghies travel to outer space in 'Hats Off to Space', then in 'In a Nut's Shell', After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs. (S1, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship in 'Camp Crossbones', then in 'A Jelly Life', SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes. (S1, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick is mistaken for a corporate retreat leader in 'Retreat!', then in 'Sidekick Search', Patrick and Squidina hold auditions for a Patrick Show sidekick. (S5, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Bubble Bass reviews The Patrick Show in 'Bubble Bass Reviews', and then in 'Patrick's Prison Pals', Bunny brings Patrick to prison for Bring Your Kid To Work Day. (S1, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Two foes take a road trip together in 'BassWard', then in 'Squidiot Box', Squidward gets lost in the imagination box. (S14, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Bikini Bottom is inhabited entirely by robots in 'Welcome to Binary Bottom', money is on the line in 'You're Going To Pay... Phone', and 'GrandPat travels through time to get home in 'A Skin Wrinkle'.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick hosts a countrified variety show. in 'Sea Haw', then in 'Li'l Past-cals', The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back. (S4, ep 6)

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Smartificial Intelligence; Firehouse Bob
nicktoons.us.description: Perch Perkins fights for his job after he's fired and replaced by a robot anchorman; SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward feel the heat when they become volunteer firefighters.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - No Pictures, Please; Stuck on the Roof
nicktoons.us.description: Patrick leads an enthusiastic stranger on a tour of his favorite places in Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob is afraid to get off the roof of the Krusty Krab, but he will not let that stop him from living his life.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Biscuit Ballyhoo; Student Driver Survivor
nicktoons.us.description: After the Science Scouts begin selling biscuits to fund a trip to Mars, Mr. Krabs enters the ring and turns it into a competition; a new driving school opens in town.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Spongicus; Suctioncup Symphony
nicktoons.us.description: Plankton builds a coliseum and holds a gladiator show; SpongeBob and Patrick keep Squidward from concentrating on his music.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Wormy; Patty Hype
nicktoons.us.description: Sandy puts SpongeBob and Patrick in charge of her pet caterpillar; SpongeBob invents colored Krabby patties.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - No Hat for Pat; Toy Store of Doom
nicktoons.us.description: Mr. Krabs offers Patrick a job holding a sign at the Krusty Krab; SpongeBob and Patrick are accidentally locked in a toy store after it closes.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!; Chum Fricassee
nicktoons.us.description: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and then the world.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Food PBBFT! Truck; Upturn Girls
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob and Squidward try to sell Krabby Patties from a food truck in the darkest depths of the ocean; Pearl and Narlene have a whales' day out in the big city.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The New Leaf; Once Bitten
nicktoons.us.description: Plankton decides to start a new business selling trinkets and souvenir gifts; Gary starts biting everyone in town.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Pablum Plankton; MuseBob ModelPants
nicktoons.us.description: Plankton wins the cutest baby contest and becomes the face of a baby food brand; when Squidward's one-off portrait of SpongeBob takes the art world by storm, he has no choice but to produce more.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Krabby Patty Creature Feature; Teacher's Pests
nicktoons.us.description: A new secret Krabby Patty formula has disastrous results for Bikini Bottom, and only SpongeBob can save the day; Mr. Krabs and Plankton have to take boating school classes.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Wiener Takes All; Stuck in an Elevator
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward takes a new job as manager of Weenie Hut Jr's; Squidward gets trapped on his way to return a nearly overdue library book.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Grandma's Kisses; Squidville
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob gets embarrassed when his grandmother kisses him in public; Squidward leaves Bikini Bottom.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Not Normal; Gone
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal; SpongeBob wakes to find that everyone in Bikini Bottom is gone.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Chum Bucket Supreme; Single Cell Anniversary
nicktoons.us.description: Plankton hires Patrick to create advertising slogans for the Chum Bucket; SpongeBob helps Plankton find the perfect anniversary gift for Karen.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Delivery of Doom; My Father the Boat
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less; when Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Bummer Vacation; Wigstuck
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob must take a day off from work; SpongeBob finds an old wig in the trash and wears it around town.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Say 'Awww!'; Patrick the Mailman
nicktoons.us.description: Frustrated that he's seen as cute instead of evil, Plankton builds a robot to punish anyone who says "aww!"; Patrick crushes the mailman, so he and SpongeBob deliver the mail around Bikini Bottom.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Good Krabby Name; Move It or Lose It
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob and Patrick go on an advertising blitz to drum up business for the Krusty Krab; Mr. Krabs and Plankton circulate petitions about the bulldozing of a Bikini Bottom restaurant.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Sanitation Insanity; Bunny Hunt
nicktoons.us.description: When Mr. Krabs gets in trouble for littering, he makes SpongeBob and Squidward clean up Bikini Bottom; a sea bunny ravages Squidward's garden, but SpongeBob thinks it's cute.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Splinter; Slide Whistle Stooges
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob tries to remove a splinter before Mr. Krabs learns about it and sends him home early; SpongeBob and Patrick get new slide whistles and keep playing them, much to the annoyance of Squidward.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Pre-Hibernation Week; Life of Crime
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob hides from Sandy; SpongeBob and Patrick borrow a balloon from a store and accidentally pop it.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Pineapple Fever; Chum Caverns
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward is stuck indoors with SpongeBob and Patrick during a storm; Plankton creates an underground restaurant that threatens to put the Krusty Krab out of business.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Who's Afraid of Mr. Snippers?; A Fish Called Sandy
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward and Plankton come together to make their very own stage play where SpongeBob is cast as the villain; Sandy decides to give herself gills so she can truly experience Bikini Bottom.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Squidtastic Voyage; That's No Lady
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward swallows his clarinet reed; Patrick disguises himself as a girl.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Captain Pipsqueak; Plane to Sea
nicktoons.us.description: Plankton joins the League of E.V.I.L.; SpongeBob and Patrick take Squidward on a plane to a tropical resort.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Squid Noir; ScavengerPants
nicktoons.us.description: When his clarinet goes missing, Squidward must become a hard-boiled detective to track it down; Squidward sends SpongeBob and Patrick on an increasingly difficult scavenger hunt to get them out of his hair.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Hello Bikini Bottom!
nicktoons.us.description: Mr. Krabs decides to manage SpongeBob and Squidward's world tour.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Squidness Protection; Dome Alone
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward's new life is threatened; stuck in her dome, Sandy suspects Plankton's up to no good and gets Patrick to investigate.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Survival of the Idiots; Dumped
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob and Patrick sneak into the Treedome; Gary follows Patrick around, and SpongeBob becomes jealous.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - A Life in a Day; Sun Bleached
nicktoons.us.description: Patrick wants to become more of a daredevil like Larry the Lobster; SpongeBob and Patrick decide to get tan so that they can attend a big party.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Clash of Triton
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob and his friends prepare for King Neptune's birthday party at the Krusty Krab.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Making Waves; Captain Quasar: The Next Generation
nicktoons.us.description: Mr. Krabs and Plankton must learn to get along after ending up shipwrecked on an island; SpongeBob and Squidina try to start their very own Captain Quasar fan club after being kicked out of Bubble Bass's.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Thing; Hocus Pocus
nicktoons.us.description: A bicycling accident leaves Squidward coated in mud and leaves; SpongeBob tries to impress Squidward with his new magic kit.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Abandon Twits; Wallhalla
nicktoons.us.description: The Krusty Crew builds a boat for its penny-pinching captain; SpongeBob discovers a crazed castaway living in his walls.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Cuddle E. Hugs; Pat the Horse
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob's new friend is a giant, fluffy hamster that no one else can see; Patrick wants to be a horse.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Extreme Spots; Squirrel Record
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob and Patrick try to join an extreme sports team; Sandy finds a book of world records and proceeds to try to break them all.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Tentacle Vision; I Heart Dancing
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward gets his own public access television show; Squidward becomes jealous of SpongeBob and tries to sabotage his dance audition.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Giant Squidward; No Nose Knows
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward turns into a giant after he is sprayed with plant growth spray; Patrick decides that he wants a nose.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - No Free Rides; I'm Your Biggest Fanatic
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob fails his driving test again; SpongeBob and Patrick go to a jellyfishing convention.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Wary Gary; Pinned
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob must go to extreme lengths when Gary refuses to go to the vet; SpongeBob gets stuck while working out.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Salty Sponge; Karen for Spot
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob works the grill at the toughest joint in town; Karen looks after Spot while Plankton goes out of town.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Growth Spout; Stuck in the Wringer
nicktoons.us.description: Pearl's growing appetite leads Mr. Krabs to sneak into his friends' houses to find some free food; SpongeBob gets stuck in his wringer after showering.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Chatterbox Gary; Don't Feed the Clowns
nicktoons.us.description: Gary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm; when a small clown gets left behind by the circus, SpongeBob takes the hapless harlequin under his wing.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Driven to Tears; Rule of Dumb
nicktoons.us.description: Patrick gets his license and wins a car; a document reveals that Patrick is next in line to become a king. (family) - 2007-02-19

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Patty Caper; Plankton's Regular
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob is in charge of delivering the secret Krabby Patty ingredient safely to the Krusty Krab; Plankton has a customer who eats at the Chum Bucket every day. (family) - 2008-08-05

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Patrick-Man!; Gary's New Toy
nicktoons.us.description: Patrick becomes a superhero and plans to clean up Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob must take drastic measures when Gary becomes obsessed with his new red ball. (family) - 2012-10-28

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

portlandia.us.description: S02 E07 Motorcycle Peter and Nance try to spice things up in their love life after someone calls Peter an old man; moving a harp.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E08 Feminist Bookstore 10th Anniversary A 10th anniversary party is thrown for Toni and Candace at the Feminist Bookstore, but a surprise guest shows up with her boyfriend.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E09 No Olympics Fred and Carrie convince the Mayor that the Olympics should be barred from Portland but quickly change their minds once they meet Olympian Greg Louganis.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E10 Brunch Village Peter, Nance, Fred, Carrie, the Mayor and most of the city of Portland find a new brunch spot which annoys Toni and Candace.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E01 Winter in Portlandia It's wintertime in Portlandia and Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets; Candace's son visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays; a couple tries to keep their food cart in business.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E02 Take Back MTV Spyke and Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens; a group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor; Sandra has a crush on a mysterious man in her meditation class.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E03 Missionaries The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland; pedicab driver hustles for clients; Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E04 Nina's Birthday Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The day-long event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night. The party turns into a Tapas Dinner.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E05 Squiggleman Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music; The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement; Malcom and Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E06 Off the Grid Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid; a dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland; musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E07 The Temp A temp worker hopes to turn her stint as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help; a wedding is interrupted; local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto; Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E08 Soft Opening Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the soft opening of their bed and breakfast; a magazine features a local furniture maker in their Man Issue; steampunks attend a convention; Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Honda Powered
powernation.us.description: A '72 Camaro gets stripped down for a fresh coat of paint and a race-ready wrap.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Honda Civic Rally Ripper Gets Safety & Seat Upgrades
powernation.us.description: Our '96 Honda Civic rally car gets racing seats for comfort and a roll cage for safety.

powernation.us.description: We wrench on our Honda 4-cylinder, updating key components and sealing oil leaks; The Civic gets a rally car-inspired paint job.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Time to Boost and Tune '96 Honda Rally Ripper
powernation.us.description: We boost our 1.6L Honda Civic rally car's power, then dyno-tune it for maximum performance on the course.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Better Handling Suspension Honda Rally Car Workout
powernation.us.description: The '96 Honda Civic gets some suspension upgrades with some new coil racing shocks; it's time to head to the rally course to put all the work to the test.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - Freeing Clint Black's Flooded F-100

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - Ford F-100 Down to the Wire
powernation.us.description: Eric and Joel scrap all the old wood, refresh some essentials, and wire the engine to fire.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - Keeping it F-100
powernation.us.description: Features installation of the remaining components to get Clint Black's old 1960 Ford F-100 back on the road again.

powernation.us.title: Truck Tech - Installing 4/6 Lowering Kit on a Chevy K1500 4x4
powernation.us.description: The 88 K1500 4WD receives a 4-to-6-inch lowering kit.

powernation.us.description: LT hoists the 350 from the engine compartment for a budget conscious 5.3L LS.

powernation.us.title: Truck Tech - AWD vs. 4WD Chevy 1500
powernation.us.description: A new plan for the Chevy K1500; tips and techniques.

powernation.us.title: Truck Tech - Upgrading a K1500 5.3 Fuel System
powernation.us.description: The '88 K1500 AWD Chevy needs more fuel for the 5.3, so it's time to feed the beast.

powernation.us.title: Truck Tech - Building a Custom K1500 Exhaust
powernation.us.description: LT shows how to build a custom exhaust, and Austin brings new life to a dull paint finish.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Abandoned Chevy Silverado Project Part 1: Rust and Dent Repair Tech
powernation.us.description: Tips on how to repair rusty trouble spots and remove dents; a walk through of getting a project primed.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Abandoned Chevy Silverado Project Part 2: Junkyard Motor Refresh
powernation.us.description: The crew source a drivetrain for a 1996 Chevy Silverado.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Abandoned Chevy Silverado Project Part 3: Custom Exhaust
powernation.us.description: The Silverado gets buttoned up underneath the hood with cooling and power steering installations.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Abandoned Chevy Silverado Project Part 4: On the Road Again
powernation.us.description: The '96 Chevy Silverado gets new body parts and gets prepped for paint.

powernation.us.title: Carcass - Abandoned Chevy Silverado Part 5: Increase Power
powernation.us.description: The Abandoned Chevy Silverado project is back for mild performance upgrades to the engine.

powernation.us.title: Trucks! - Second Chance Silverado Part 1
powernation.us.description: We rescued this 2001 Chevy Silverado from being parted out by an auto recycler to begin transforming it into a sharp everyday street truck; we'll tackle replacing the damaged body panels with an eye to spending as little as possible.

powernation.us.title: Trucks! - Second Chance Silverado Part 2: Body Panel Replacement
powernation.us.description: The replacement body panels are added.

powernation.us.title: Trucks! - Second Chance Silverado Part 3: Color Match Painting
powernation.us.description: Making the Chevy Silverado the right color again.

powernation.us.title: Trucks! - Second Chance Silverado Part 4: Upgrades
powernation.us.description: Our Second Chance Silverado is back and is set to get a leveling kit and upgrades in the power, suspension and wheels and tires departments.

powernation.us.title: Powernation Builds - Spicy Granada
powernation.us.description: Pat and Frankie from Engine Power rescue an abandoned 1977 Ford Granada and turn it into a spicy sleeper.

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - 496ci Stroker Big Block Chevy
powernation.us.description: We put custom touches on our 496ci Stroker Big Block and get it ready for the street rod life!

powernation.us.description: Hosts Marc Christ and Brandon Burke mix Nashville's flavor and excitement with cool truck builds including classic and late model pickups, sport trucks and SUVs.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - OBS 632 SS Part 2 Chassis Chaos
powernation.us.description: The OBS Chevy is in the shop to mock up its new suspension; making a few modifications to the spring pockets before installing the front suspension; addressing frame issues before adding a c-notch to get the rear suspension in place.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - OBS 632 SS Part 3 Building Blocks
powernation.us.description: OBS 632 SS frame mods: boxing plates, fuel tank mockup, clutch install, drivetrain drop.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - OBS 632 SS Part 4 Taking Shape
powernation.us.description: The OBS 632 is getting fuel and brake lines, custom exhaust, a stripped cab and bed mods.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - OBS 632 SS Part 5 Color Cover Up
powernation.us.description: We build a Ford 9-inch for the OBS Chevy and show an inexpensive interior panel color change.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - OBS 632 SS Part 6 Some Assembly Required
powernation.us.description: The OBS Chevy chassis is back from powder coat; we start assembly to get the sport truck running again.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks
powernation.us.description: Hosts Marc Christ and Brandon Burke mix Nashville's flavor with truck builds, including classic and late-model pickups, sport trucks and SUVs.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - OBS 632 SS Part 8 Sport Truck Assemble/Crossing the Finish Line
powernation.us.description: Putting the final touches on the 632 OBS Chevy; finishing the interior, adding exterior details, and hitting the road.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - Wheeling and Dealing on a 2007 Jeep Wrangler
powernation.us.description: The team ventures to the north Georgia mountains to pick up and test an '07 Jeep Wrangler JK.

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - Stroked Stock Mopar Magnum
powernation.us.description: The 360 Magnum engine gets fifty extra cubic inches from a forged stroker kit.

powernation.us.title: Music City Trucks - 2021 Ford Bronco Upgrades
powernation.us.description: A brand new 2021 Ford Bronco comes into the shop to make it better.

powernation.us.title: Powernation Builds - TrashHawk
powernation.us.description: Today our guys are taking some liberties transforming a Jeep Wagoneer into an S-U-V performance beast.

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - 318 LA Resurrection
powernation.us.description: Pro engine tips on assembling and tuning everything from street engines to full-race motors.

powernation.us.title: Under the Hood - Jason Mode - Dark Matters C10
powernation.us.description: Dark Matters, Jason Mode's '68 C10, is a subtly modded, powerful truck with killer black and red style.

powernation.us.title: Detroit Muscle - Project Struck Out
powernation.us.description: As we resume work on our 1966 Chevy Nova, we learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out.

Sean and Jack's lives collide, and an unexpected bond forms between them.

pursuitchannel.us.description: The November rut has whitetails going crazy in West Virginia's steep mountain country; Kenny is right in the thick of it. Using proven bow hunting tactics, he sets up at a pinch point where several bucks have been passing by the Spartan Trail Cam.

pursuitchannel.us.description: This week on The High Road, Keith Warren and Johnny Piazza are joined by Eric and Olivia from Sticky Holsters for a hog hunt in Texas. Johnny is on a mission to get Olivia her first hogs using thermal optics. Meanwhile, Keith is trying to get Eric...

pursuitchannel.us.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony - Crazy Black Friday Deals
pursuitchannel.us.description: The biggest Black Friday sale ever. Headlamps are free, no purchase necessary. Broadheads $5.00 a pack and a whole lot more.

pursuitchannel.us.title: Wallhanger Tv - Kentucky with Friends
pursuitchannel.us.description: Horseback rides, time with friends, and a Kentucky deer hunt remind Dana what the hunting lifestyle is really about.

pursuitchannel.us.title: North American Trapper Showcase - Coyote and Nest Raider Methods
pursuitchannel.us.description: Proven trapping setups for handling raccoons, coyotes and other nuisance animals, with specific tips on handling them all on your property.

pursuitchannel.us.title: Modern Hunter - Shaking in the Lone Star State
pursuitchannel.us.description: In this episode: wWAxis deer hunt. After spending time glassing and searching the property, Brad gets opportunities at both a mature buck and a doe. Watch the action unfold as he fills both tags and enjoys a successful Texas hunt.

pursuitchannel.us.description: Terry finds himself back in Texas hunting with Steve Biggers of Rocky Creek Retrievers.

pursuitchannel.us.title: Slock Master - Impala show Africa 1

retroplex.us.title: The Proud Rebel
retroplex.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

retroplex.us.title: Vengeance Valley
retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner.
