screamboxtv.us.description: A writer (William Devane) and a TV newswoman (Cathy Lee Crosby) link a California killing spree to an alien werewolf in blue jeans.

screamboxtv.us.title: Samurai Wolf II: Hell Cut
screamboxtv.us.description: Skilled ronin Kiba wanders the Japanese countryside and finds himself facing off against a skilled swordsman, a crooked goldmine owner, a manipulative woman and a dojo master.

screamboxtv.us.title: The Last Thanksgiving
screamboxtv.us.description: A family of cannibalistic Pilgrims attacks the staff and patrons at a restaurant that stays open for Thanksgiving rather than close in celebration of the holiday.

screamboxtv.us.title: Bloody Bites
screamboxtv.us.description: S18 E05 Wild Animal In the early hours of the morning, Mallory, a wealthy woman, finds an abandoned baby; she drives the baby to a caravan park and abandons it there to be found by someone else; however, she feels like the child's mother is stalking her.

screamboxtv.us.title: Creature From the Haunted Sea
screamboxtv.us.description: After political unrest breaks out on a Caribbean island, scheming criminal Renzo Capetto (Anthony Carbone) promises to transport a group of exiles out of the country while also taking part of the national treasury.

screamboxtv.us.title: Shocking Dark
screamboxtv.us.description: A team of soldiers and civilians are sent to Venice to investigate the mysterious deaths of scientists who are trying to clean polluted waters.

screamboxtv.us.title: Slumber Party Massacre II
screamboxtv.us.description: Courtney and her friends go to their condo for a weekend getaway, but Courtney can't get rid of the haunting feeling that a supernatural rockabilly driller killer is coming to murder them all.

screamboxtv.us.title: Humanoids From the Deep
screamboxtv.us.description: A fisherman (Doug McClure) and a scientist (Ann Turkel) fight back when mossy sea monsters assault women.

screamboxtv.us.title: Class of 1984
screamboxtv.us.description: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

screamboxtv.us.title: Sleepaway Camp
screamboxtv.us.description: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

screamboxtv.us.title: Humanoids From the Deep
screamboxtv.us.description: A fisherman (Doug McClure) and a scientist (Ann Turkel) fight back when mossy sea monsters assault women.

screenpix.us.title: Hawaii
screenpix.us.description: During the 1820s, a domineering young minister, Abner Hale (Max von Sydow), and his compassionate wife, Jerusha (Julie Andrews), embark on a dangerous sea voyage to Hawaii. When they arrive, Jerusha befriends the Hawaiian people and embraces their customs and culture, while Abner, intent on converting them to Christianity, views them as pagan savages. Jerusha grows unhappy with her marriage and begins to fall for Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), a past lover.

screenpix.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
screenpix.us.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

screenpix.us.title: Feast of Love
screenpix.us.description: The love lives of several people of various ages intersect when a young woman named Chloe (Alexa Davalos) comes to town. Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss.

screenpix.us.title: Time Limit
screenpix.us.description: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

screenpix.us.title: Stolen Hours
screenpix.us.description: Laura (Susan Hayward), an American heiress in London, is a party girl living it up, in denial of her serious illness. She rebuffs the concerns of her ex-lover (Edward Judd) and keeps her health a secret from her sister (Diane Baker). Eventually, John (Michael Craig), a handsome doctor, demands she get treatment, and Laura finally listens. Doctor and patient fall in love and move to a house on the Cornish coast. In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace.

screenpix.us.title: A Prayer for the Dying
screenpix.us.description: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). Unfortunately, a priest (Bob Hoskins) complicates matters by witnessing the hit, but Fallon believes he knows how to keep him silent.

screenpix.us.title: The Boss
screenpix.us.description: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

screenpixaction.us.title: Code 46
screenpixaction.us.description: In a dystopian future, insurance fraud investigator William Geld (Tim Robbins) arrives in Shanghai to investigate a forgery ring for "papelles," futuristic passports that record people's identities and genetics. Geld falls for Maria Gonzalez (Samantha Morton), the woman in charge of the forgeries. After a passionate affair, Geld returns home, having named a coworker as the culprit. But when one of Gonzalez's customers is found dead, Geld is sent back to Shanghai to complete the investigation.

screenpixaction.us.title: Master of the World
screenpixaction.us.description: Mad inventor Capt. Robur kidnaps a team on a government expedition to investigate a mysterious crater in Pennsylvania. The team is taken aboard Robur's spectacularly engineered air ship, the Albatross, which Robur plans to fly around the world to various military installations in his desperate desire to eradicate weapons of mass destruction, thereby bringing about world peace. The kidnapped team's leader, John Strock, responds by planning an uprising.

screenpixaction.us.title: Eve of Destruction
screenpixaction.us.description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

screenpixaction.us.title: Journey to the Seventh Planet
screenpixaction.us.description: An astronaut (John Agar) leads U.N. explorers to Uranus, where a giant eye feeds them images from their minds.

screenpixaction.us.title: Beyond the Time Barrier
screenpixaction.us.description: A pilot crashes through the time barrier into the world of 2024, inhabited by the last remnants of civilization.

screenpixaction.us.title: Panic in Year Zero
screenpixaction.us.description: As the Baldwin family heads on vacation, their hometown of Los Angeles falls victim to a nuclear attack. Harry (Ray Milland), his wife, Ann (Jean Hagen), and their two teens head to their fishing retreat in the mountains, hoping to regroup and get more information. But they can't escape the frantic and irrational citizens, most of whom are dangerously deranged. Harry tries to stay calm during the nuclear-inspired end of days, but it's tempting to follow the masses' frenzied behavior.

screenpixaction.us.title: Khyber Patrol
screenpixaction.us.description: British lancers court their commander's daughter and patrol the Khyber Pass.

screenpixaction.us.title: Top of the World
screenpixaction.us.description: A jet pilot finds himself assigned to the barren wastes of Alaska where it becomes his duty to man an observation post.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Thousand Plane Raid
screenpixaction.us.description: Colonel Greg Brandon (Christopher George), an American serving at a Royal Air Force base in England, has a grand military dream: a risky plan to send a fleet of 1,000 bombers to a German airplane factory as a strategic strike. Brandon badgers his commanding officers until he has his way, losing friends and alienating people as he goes. When the raid arrives, Brandon sees the wisdom and valor of his fellow soldiers and realizes that caution is just as important as zeal.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Sharkfighters
screenpixaction.us.description: Navy pilot Ben Staves (Victor Mature) arrives at a research facility on a small Caribbean island to help develop a shark repellent for use by sailors and downed airmen. Partnered with scientists Leonard Evans (Philip Coolidge) and Harold Duncan (James Olson), Staves provides valuable information about his own time stranded in the ocean. But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

screenpixvoices.us.description: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) innovates 1960s rock 'n' roll, then dies of a drug overdose at 27.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Rappin'
screenpixvoices.us.description: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Beat Street
screenpixvoices.us.description: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
screenpixvoices.us.description: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bojangles
screenpixvoices.us.description: Based on the life of tap-dancing legend Bill Robinson -- also known as Mr. Bojangles -- the film follows Robinson as he climbs his way up the entertainment ladder from lowly vaudeville performer to one of the greatest black entertainers of his time. However, despite Robinson's meteoric rise and the support of his loyal agent, Marty Forkins, his compulsive gambling and love of women keep him from enjoying the success his talents have earned him.

screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat agrees to pose as a prisoner to gain the confidence of a criminal who hid a string of black pearls he stole, but when the man's sister arrives his job gets harder.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
screenpixwesterns.us.description: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Frontier Uprising
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Defiance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Drango
screenpixwesterns.us.description: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Yuma
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Apaches plan to attack a fort by wearing uniforms plundered from a cavalry officer's (Peter Graves) supply column.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Geronimo
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. However, life on the San Carlos reservation is difficult, and the Apaches do not adjust well to becoming farmers. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Outlaw's Son
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Young Jeff Blaine (Joseph Stafford) is being raised by his Aunt Ruth (Ellen Drew) because his absentee father, Nate (Dane Clark), is an outlaw. When Nate suddenly shows up, hoping to get custody of Jeff, Ruth opposes the idea, and forces Nate to flee by framing him for a robbery. Years later, the adult Jeff (Ben Cooper), who never forgave Ruth for her deception, begins to search for his fugitive father, and becomes an outlaw himself when he engages in an ill-advised stagecoach robbery.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Conspiracy
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A bartender is killed after he takes on another identity and sells a scandal-ridden story to a newspaper.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Ghost Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Barbara Leighton (Marian Carr) travels by stagecoach to a small frontier town, the home of her fiancé, Duff Dailey (John Smith). When Dailey and miner Kerry "Crusty" McCabe (William Phillips) find the coach station ransacked by dangerous Cheyenne fighters, they board the stagecoach and swear to protect Leighton and the rest of the passengers. As the Cheyenne close in, the weary travelers hole up at a saloon in a nearby ghost town -- and prepare for the longest night of their lives.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Glory Guys
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Off Mic
scrippsnews.us.description: For four decades, sports broadcasting pioneers Suzy Kolber and Lisa Salters have told everyone else's story. The championship runs. The comebacks. The night Damar Hamlin's heart stopped, and millions hung on their every word. Through all of it, their own stories - flourishing in a male-dominated business, juggling single motherhood with a demanding career - stayed off the mic. Until now.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Dual Threat
scrippsnews.us.description: Steve Young redefined the quarterback position, setting records as both passer and rusher during his Hall of Fame career; behind the scenes, he battled crippling anxiety that was tougher than any opponent; when football was over, he built a $10 billion business from scratch; Suzy Kolber reconnects with her former broadcast partner to find out what it takes to be a dual threat — on the field and in life.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Gruden: A Love Story
scrippsnews.us.description: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention—including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end—and whether the sideline is still calling.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Kristen Bell
scrippsnews.us.description: Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Samuel L. Jackson & LaTanya Richardson Jackson
scrippsnews.us.description: Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - LeVar Burton
scrippsnews.us.description: Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Joe Namath
scrippsnews.us.description: Joe Namath grew up in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. After his parents' divorce, Joe turned to sports; he was propelled into sports stardom in college and professional football earning the nickname Broadway Joe.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Gruden: A Love Story

Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention—including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end—and whether the sideline is still calling.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Ice Dreams
scrippsnews.us.description: Digit Murphy built women's hockey from the bench and the boardroom - coaching, fighting and lobbying long before the lights came on. Hilary Knight became the face of women's hockey, setting records, winning Olympic gold twice, and carrying a sport on her back. Suzy Kolber sits down with both trailblazers to examine what it costs to love a sport that didn't always love you back.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Flag Bearers
scrippsnews.us.description: Former Canadian quarterback Sam Rapoport creates NFL paths for women while developing global flag football; Mexican quarterback Diana Flores elevates the sport internationally following a featured commercial; broadcaster Suzy Kolber interviews both leaders on taking flag football to the LA twenty twenty-eight Olympics.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Savannah's Top Banana
scrippsnews.us.description: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Texas
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 2 Longhorns (11-1) try to exact revenge on the No. 5 Bulldogs (10-2) in the SEC championship game. Georgia won at Texas 30-15 on Oct. 19. The Bulldogs make their fourth consecutive title-game appearance. Georgia defeated LSU 50-30 in 2022.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
shadesofblack.us.description: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

shadesofblack.us.title: Moonlight
shadesofblack.us.description: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support and love of the community that helps raise him.

shadesofblack.us.title: Falcon Rising
shadesofblack.us.description: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

shadesofblack.us.title: Monster's Ball
shadesofblack.us.description: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

shadesofblack.us.title: Triple Threat
shadesofblack.us.description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

shadesofblack.us.title: As Good as Dead
shadesofblack.us.description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos
shadesofblack.us.description: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Island
shadesofblack.us.description: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

shoutmovies.us.title: Funny Games
shoutmovies.us.description: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

shoutmovies.us.title: JCVD
shoutmovies.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

shoutmovies.us.title: Downfall
shoutmovies.us.description: As the Third Reich crumbles around them, Adolf Hitler's secretary witnesses the final 10 days of the Nazi dictator's life.

shoutmovies.us.title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
shoutmovies.us.description: S01 E01 An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

shoutmovies.us.title: Escape to Athena
shoutmovies.us.description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

shoutmovies.us.title: Journey to the End of the Night
shoutmovies.us.description: A man (Brendan Fraser) hatches a scheme to double-cross his father (Scott Glenn) and steal money from a drug deal.

shoutmovies.us.title: Magic
shoutmovies.us.description: A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.

showtime.us.title: True Grit
showtime.us.description: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

showtime.us.title: Saving Private Ryan
showtime.us.description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

showtime.us.title: Dunkirk
showtime.us.description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

showtime.us.title: Behind Enemy Lines
showtime.us.description: A Navy admiral (Gene Hackman) orders the rescue of a fighter pilot (Owen Wilson) after the Serbs shoot down his plane in Bosnia.

showtime.us.title: Troy
showtime.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

showtime.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtime.us.description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

showtime.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtime.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtime.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtime.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtime.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtime.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail. (Movies, Adventure) - 1989

showtime2west.us.title: Office Christmas Party
showtime2west.us.description: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

showtime2west.us.title: The Intern
showtime2west.us.description: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss.

showtime2west.us.title: Twister
showtime2west.us.description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

showtime2west.us.title: Argo
showtime2west.us.description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

showtime2west.us.title: Up in the Air
showtime2west.us.description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

showtime2west.us.title: Yellowjackets
showtime2west.us.description: A team of talented high school girls soccer players survives a plane crash deep in the remote northern wilderness.

showtime2west.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
showtime2west.us.description: Beavis and Butt-head travel from Las Vegas to Washington, D.C., not realizing that their landlord has sent them to kill his wife.

showtime2west.us.title: Vanilla Sky
showtime2west.us.description: A wealthy womanizer (Tom Cruise) has trouble distinguishing dreams from reality after a car accident leaves him disfigured.

showtime2west.us.title: Top Gun
showtime2west.us.description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

showtime2west.us.title: The Hunt for Red October
showtime2west.us.description: Moscow, Washington and a CIA analyst (Alec Baldwin) track a renegade Soviet captain (Sean Connery) and his new submarine.

showtime2west.us.title: Dunkirk
showtime2west.us.description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Enemy at the Gates
showtimeextreme.us.description: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Patriot Games
showtimeextreme.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Hunt for Red October
showtimeextreme.us.description: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

showtimeextreme.us.title: V for Vendetta
showtimeextreme.us.description: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy.

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Godfather Part II
showtimeextreme.us.description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Tommy Boy
showtimeextreme.us.description: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Jacob's Ladder
showtimeextreme.us.description: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Uncommon Valor
showtimeextreme.us.description: Col. Cal Rhodes (Gene Hackman), a retired Marine officer, holds out hope that his son, believed to be a prisoner of war in Laos, is still alive. Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos. (movie) - 1983

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtimefamily.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtimefamily.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtimefamily.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
showtimefamily.us.description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

showtimefamily.us.title: Smoke Signals
showtimefamily.us.description: A geeky American Indian travels from Idaho to Phoenix with a stoic companion whose father died.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Honeymooners
showtimefamily.us.description: New York bus driver Ralph Kramden and pal Ed Norton test their wives' patience with moneymaking schemes that end in failure.

showtimefamily.us.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
showtimefamily.us.description: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

showtimefamily.us.title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
showtimefamily.us.description: A smart child (Debi Derryberry) and his mechanical dog blast into outer space after aliens kidnap adults from his hometown.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Little Prince
showtimefamily.us.description: The Aviator introduces a girl to a world where she rediscovers her childhood and learns that it's human connections that matter most, and that it is only with heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.

showtimefamily.us.title: Charlotte's Web
showtimefamily.us.description: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider (Julia Roberts) weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block.

showtimefamily.us.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
showtimefamily.us.description: When Stu Pickles must travel to Paris to work on a new amusement park, the gang accompanies him.

showtimefamily.us.title: Chocolat
showtimefamily.us.description: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

showtimenext.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtimenext.us.description: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it.

showtimenext.us.title: No Strings Attached
showtimenext.us.description: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

showtimenext.us.title: He's Just Not That Into You
showtimenext.us.description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

showtimenext.us.title: Almost Famous
showtimenext.us.description: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

showtimenext.us.title: Election
showtimenext.us.description: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

showtimenext.us.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
showtimenext.us.description: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor.

showtimenext.us.title: Wakefield
showtimenext.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned.

showtimenext.us.title: Mary Shelley
showtimenext.us.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's family disapproves when she and poet Percy Shelley announce their love for each other. The family is horrified when it finds that the couple has eloped, accompanied by Mary's half-sister, Claire. While staying in the home of Lord Byron at Lake Geneva, the guests are challenged to write a ghost story, which leads Mary to conceive her novel Frankenstein.

showtimenext.us.title: Love Me
showtimenext.us.description: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

showtimenext.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimenext.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. (movie) - 2022

showtimenext.us.title: Run
showtimenext.us.description: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. (movie) - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Noah
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Not Without Hope
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Pike River
showtimeshowcase.us.description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: World Trade Center
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Reindeer Games
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shakespeare in Love
showtimeshowcase.us.description: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays. (movie) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Office Christmas Party
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. (movie) - 2016

showtimewomen.us.title: Terms of Endearment
showtimewomen.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children.

showtimewomen.us.title: Everybody's Fine
showtimewomen.us.description: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be.

showtimewomen.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
showtimewomen.us.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

showtimewomen.us.title: The First Wives Club
showtimewomen.us.description: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes.

showtimewomen.us.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
showtimewomen.us.description: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

showtimewomen.us.title: Happy Christmas
showtimewomen.us.description: An immature party girl (Anna Kendrick) moves in with her brother's family to get over a breakup and throws their lives out of whack.

showtimewomen.us.title: Don Jon
showtimewomen.us.description: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

showtimewomen.us.title: A Christmas Proposal
showtimewomen.us.description: Hoping to impress his family during a Christmas visit, a hotshot Seattle attorney asks a down-on-her-luck chef to pose as his girlfriend. Their business arrangement soon gets complicated as real sparks begin to fly during the holiday season.

showtimewomen.us.title: The Guilt Trip
showtimewomen.us.description: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

showtimewomen.us.title: Dreamgirls
showtimewomen.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame. (movie) - 2006

showtimewomen.us.title: Selena
showtimewomen.us.description: In this biographical drama, Selena Quintanilla (Jennifer Lopez) is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. Her father, Abraham (Edward James Olmos), realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete. (movie) - 1997

showtimewomen.us.title: Footloose
showtimewomen.us.description: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way. (movie) - 1984

shoxbetwest.us.title: 48 HRS.
shoxbetwest.us.description: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Another 48 Hrs.
shoxbetwest.us.description: Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond. This time it is to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco Bay Area.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Norbit
shoxbetwest.us.description: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Dreamgirls
shoxbetwest.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Fighting Temptations
shoxbetwest.us.description: Advertising executive Darrin Hill (Cuba Gooding Jr.) loses his job and his girlfriend after his many lies about his background and education are discovered. Soon after, he returns to his small Georgia hometown to collect an inheritance from his Aunt Sally (Ann Nesby). To receive it, he must lead the church choir to victory in a gospel competition. With the help of childhood friend Lilly (Beyoncé Knowles), now a beautiful singer, Darrin gets the choir ready to perform.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Nobody's Fool
shoxbetwest.us.description: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems.

shoxbetwest.us.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
shoxbetwest.us.description: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The One and Only Dick Gregory
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Andre Gaines examines the remarkable life and career of stand-up comic, activist and pop culture icon Dick Gregory. Features interviews with Dave Chappelle, Chris Rock, Kevin Hart and others.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Love & Basketball
shoxbetwest.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (movie) - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour
shoxbetwest.us.description: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. (movie) - 1998

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. (movie) - 2001

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Daughter of the Demon
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Actress Katrina Law ("Arrow") wants a copy of Batman 232; old school items involving Popeye, Dynomutt and Pogs.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt steps into the ring with a customer over an original Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots game; a rare piece of original Sal Buscema art.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Marky Ramone-Bot
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Marky Ramone shares his artwork and bonds with Walt over robots; a King Kong item from 1975.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Amazing Walter
slightlyoffifc.us.description: A Kreskin ESP game reveals Walt's powers of cognition; discussions about Mork from Ork and Dick Tracy's Rogues' Gallery.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Reverse Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Tom Cavanaugh visits the shop; Walt finds a Golden Age classic with "Human Torch No. 2."

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Return of the Living Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin Smith and the guys discuss how "The Walking Dead" started out as a comic book and became a cultural phenomenon.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Nightmare on Broad Street
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Hail to the King
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Method Man's Mego
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Influential actor and rapper Method Man talks to the guys about his extensive comic book collection; "Starsky & Hutch" gear takes over The Stash.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Stash Bash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - In a Galaxy Very Nearby
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Rare and interesting Star Wars items making their way into the Stash; Walt offers up big cash to try and score a beacon for the store.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Ode to Clerks
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin Smith and the guys attend the premiere screening of a movie about themselves and the origination of the film "Clerks."

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Canine Crusaders
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Actor Burt Ward, best known for portraying television's famous Robin the Boy Wonder, reminisces about his time on the set of "Batman" and judges the Stash's canine cosplay contest.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Power Man vs. Counter Man
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Troma-tized
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - A Pez-tacular Mystery
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Mightiest of Mortals
slightlyoffifc.us.description: When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Pop Goes the Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Junk
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Life After Clerks
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin rallies the Stash for a game of street hockey; hurricane Mewes blows through the Stash, and no one is safe.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Commercial
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt wants the Stash to shoot its first commercial and to have Bryan direct it; one customer brings in a fanboy's dream.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Zombies
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt reluctantly lets Ming run a new sales promotion for the Stash based around zombies, but Ming's scary idea might be too frightening for Walt.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Doc Martin - Return to Sender
slightlyoffifc.us.description: A year has passed since Martin resigned his medical license, and his wife, Louisa, is now the one seeing patients as a child counselor.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Doc Martin - Love Will Set You Free
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The news of Martin's invitation to be dean of Imperial College spreads through Portwenn, before Martin and Louisa can decide whether he will take the job; Mrs. Tishell and Penhale are crushed; Morwenna questions what she wants to do with her life.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Doc Martin - Our Last Summer
slightlyoffifc.us.description: As the Ellinghams prepare to leave for London, Ruth admits to Martin that she's been writing a paper on his blood phobia; Ruth is counseling Mrs. Tishell on how to overcome her obsession with the Doc; Penhale anxiously arranges their goodbye party.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Doc Martin - Last Christmas in Portwenn
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Portwenn is full of festive cheer until Martin tells Leonard he needs to stop playing Santa while he awaits the results of his medical tests; Leonard decides to show Doc the Grinch the magic of Christmas; Louisa works to arrange a Christmas parade.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Con Gone Wrong
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt and the guys take a road trip to an unexpected convention; the guys find a treasure in the trash; a customer brings in an item Mike wants for himself.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Ink
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Ming dares Walt, Bryan and Mike to get tattoos; one customer looks for romance while another makes a deal.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Stash Bashes
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt and the guys throw a birthday party at the Stash; larger-than-life Darth Vader helmet.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - My Big Fat Geek Wedding
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The guys attend a local auction; bad results from mixing comic books and cigars.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Ghostbusting at the Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The guys pursue the Jersey Devil; selling Thundercat figures.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Ming in Charge
slightlyoffifc.us.description: When Walt and Mike fall ill, Ming must run Stash by himself; first issues of Iron Man and Daredevil.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Running Dead
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Mike and Ming participate in a 5K zombie run for Kevin's charity; Walt buys an unusual item.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Tough S...
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin visits the Stash for a book signing; Jay acts as security; a customer brings in original artwork.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Clash at the Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The Stash sells an independent comic book, so the guys can see a costumed MMA fight; Walt buys nostalgic underwear.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: First-person accounts and rare color footage detail the final 100 days of World War II in Europe.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Apocalypse: The Second World War - Shock
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: As the war continues into 1941, the conflict goes truly global with the savage battle for Moscow and Japan's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor. Shock - S01E03

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Apocalypse: World War II - World Ablaze
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: America joins the war; the conflict rages in South-East Asia, North Africa and Russia; the Nazis instigate The Final Solution. World Ablaze - S01E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The death toll rises as the war reaches its conclusion. The Noose - S01E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The Allies' heroics keep Hitler from advancing; the Red Army arrives in Berlin. Inferno - S01E06

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - An Ocean Apart
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: A look at life in the Pacific before, during, and after the attack on Pearl Harbor, presented through home movies and combat footage. An Ocean Apart - S01E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - Shockwaves
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Months after the Pearl Harbor attack, shock waves reverberate in every corner of the Pacific; Americans deploy to stem the enemy's advance; after culture clashes, Allied forces later bond over efforts to thwart Japan's move to control New Guinea. Shockwaves - S01E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - Island Hopping
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: In 1943, the United States engages in a new series of island-hopping invasions; the first stop is the Tarawa Atoll, where troops embark upon the largest amphibious invasion ever staged in the Pacific to fight one of the costliest battles of the war. Island Hopping - S01E03

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - The Enemy Underground
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: By the summer of 1944, the United States is gaining the upper hand in the Pacific War with better training, troop numbers and supply lines; it aims for the heart of Japan's inner defense ring, engaging in a naval battle for Saipan in the Marianas. The Enemy Underground - S01E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - Striking Distance
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Allied forces move to take the valuable islands of Tinian and Guam that threaten American air operations; meanwhile, Gen. Curtis LeMay is tasked with planning and executing a firebombing campaign against Japan. Striking Distance - S01E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - Fire From the Sky
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Allies slug it out on the island of Peleliu in a campaign to pave the way for Gen. MacArthur's return to the Philippines; footage shows troops enduring the muddy muck in the Philippines; Japan unveils a devastating new tactic, the kamikaze. Fire From the Sky - S01E06

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - No Surrender
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: By the spring of 1945, the United States begins to take back the Philippines; on Borneo, the Australians invade Labuan; when the United States invades Okinawa, Japan makes a strong stand and launches the biggest kamikaze attacks of the war. No Surrender - S01E07

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: The Pacific War in Color - From the Ashes
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: President Harry Truman decides to drop the atomic bomb on Hiroshima and Nagasaki; Emperor Hirohito surrenders, and Gen. Douglas MacArthur arrives to oversee the country's occupation; mortal enemies must now become partners in Japan's rebirth. From the Ashes - S01E08

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Lazarus Project
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: It Could Happen to You
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
sonymoviechannel.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Defendor
sonymoviechannel.us.description: An everyday guy (Woody Harrelson) believes he is a superhero and befriends a teenager while seeing a psychiatrist.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: The Medallion
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Eddie (Jackie Chan) is an indomitable Hong Kong cop who, after a near fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion, is suddenly transformed into a Highbinder -- an immortal warrior with inhuman powers. Eddie enlists the help of fellow agent Nicole (Claire Forlani) to determine the secret of the medallion and face down the evil Highbinders who so desperately want it back.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: In the Line of Duty: Smoke Jumpers
sonymoviechannel.us.description: A wilderness firefighter's (Adam Baldwin) love of danger threatens his relationship with his wife (Lindsay Frost) and family.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: They Came to Cordura
sonymoviechannel.us.description: On a mission to Mexico, U.S. Maj. Tom Thorn is branded a coward, while several of his fellow servicemen are praised for showing bravery. Tom is asked to transport the heroes through harsh terrain so they can be honored. Also along for the journey is Adelaide Geary, a woman charged with conspiring against the United States. But, as his fellow soldiers begin revealing their treacherous sides, Tom realizes that Adelaide is the only heroic one of the bunch.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Dirty
sonymoviechannel.us.description: Armando Sancho is a former Los Angeles gang member who has transitioned into law enforcement. Sancho, however, who is surrounded by corruption, finds that life as a police officer is just as morally bankrupt as life as a gangster. After being implicated in the shooting of an innocent man himself, Sancho is then pressured to testify against his loose-cannon friend and partner, Salim Adel, who has a history of abusing citizens.

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Linewatch

sonymoviechannel.us.title: Tears of the Sun
sonymoviechannel.us.description: The Nigerian government has fallen, and the country is on the verge of civil war. Lt. A.K. Waters (Bruce Willis) has been assigned to lead a team of soldiers into the Nigerian jungle to rescue Dr. Lena Kendricks (Monica Bellucci). When Waters and his team locate Kendricks, she tells them she won't leave her helpless patients to be slaughtered by rebels. The team incurs the wrath of both U.S. and Nigerian forces when they side with Kendricks and attempt to march the refugees to safety. (movie) - 2003

spectrumoc16.us.title: Outside Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: The late Dr. Ruth Gates encourages investment of time in the study of the ocean and its importance to us and future generations. Waianae Intermediate students visit a Hawaiian Plants restoration site. Shore fishing and diving in Kona.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Joy of Crafting
spectrumoc16.us.description: Brandon Tavares makes a poinsettia from chenille stems; Kristi Ige shows a quick and easy way to start a deco mesh wreath; Joy uses Hearty Clay and paint to create a cute see-through ornament.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Fashion Sense by Valerie
spectrumoc16.us.description: Glitter yogurt bark, a sparkling stretch from Gina that sparks positivity and how to wear the metallic trend.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Showcase Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Inspired by Hawaii, the Ekolu Plumeria CZ Ring features three plumeria blossoms, each centered with a sparkling cubic zirconia. Gold-plated over copper, it captures island elegance. Available in sizes 6 to 10.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Champ Show
spectrumoc16.us.description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Goes Fishing
spectrumoc16.us.description: The Dut's Papio Challenge at Kaneohe Bay. Cub Scouts learn about Hawaiian fishponds. Flashbombs catch the attention of menpachi at night. How to prevent twisted lines, a papio and ulua recipe, and an option to replace a rusting trailer bracket.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Lanai's Travel Club
spectrumoc16.us.description: Lanai hits Bangkok, Thailand for bold bites, vibrant culture, fascinating people and sky-high rooftop bars with epic views.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ninth Island Connection
spectrumoc16.us.description: Talk with Plaza CEO Jonathan Jossel, former mayor and attorney-to-the-mob Oscar Goodman, and Chef Ben Jenkins of Oscar's Steakhouse.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV
spectrumoc16.us.description: We take a look at when things go wrong. Big wave wipeouts, mountain biking crashes and even road rashes on skateboards.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ocean Paddler TV
spectrumoc16.us.description: Paddlers of all kinds attempt to cross the Ka'iwi Channel in the Maui Jim Molokai Challenge.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
spectrumoc16.us.description: Times Supermarket not only provides our groceries but also serves up ono poke and plate lunches. Chelsea Kea, Kauai Food Service Supervisor, shares some of the recipes you can find in the stores like their Orange Sesame Salmon.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Skin Diver ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Hanalei Adric takes us to the west side of Oahu as he shares new technology while diving for octopus with an underwater scooter.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Sports People Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Thor lives up to his name by pushing himself to the limit and doctors fix him so he can continue living life to the fullest. Bryan Gomes likes to live life in the fast lane. And meet a lady who loves to get deep in the ocean, world-record deep.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Board Stories ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Get close-up with Zoe McDougall, Cyrus Sutton of Island Earth and Torrey Meister.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ultimate Japan
spectrumoc16.us.description: The Suzukis will start off their day at a chinsuko (Okinawan cookie) factory. Mayumi shops at Kokusai Dori or International Street. Skyler plays an interesting Okinawan flute, and they enjoy Okinawa's specialty food, goat.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Everything Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: Behind-the-scenes of how the show is made, off-the-beaten-path splashes, a rescue of an unusual creature, and Kawika's favorite adventures. Plus insights from a UH Hilo student and a treasured Hawaii Island kupuna.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Dut's Grindz & Goodtimes
spectrumoc16.us.description: Learn what goes into a traditional street dog at the Eastside Kitchen food truck.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Da Braddahs & Friends
spectrumoc16.us.description: James Roache and Tony Silva are the duo known as Da Braddahs. Their show, "Da Braddahs and Friends", takes local comedy to another level with their wild antics and unforgettable characters.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Painting in Paradise
spectrumoc16.us.description: Hawaii's Nature Artist Patrick Ching takes local ohana on nature adventures then shows them and the television audience how to draw and paint their favorite things.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Flippin Uce
spectrumoc16.us.description: With city inspectors giving the green light, it's full steam ahead; crews install drywall while electricians prep new lighting and outlets; concrete is poured for walkways, a ramp and fencing; the project's vision is coming to life.
